card.title: Lost in the Process
card.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parcel got caught between reception and dispatch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left it on the bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dispatch handed it to transport without a receipt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Both departments are you. Call the bus company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll report a failure across dispatch, transport and receipt control. They'll need to investigate all three.

relationship.evidence: B2 knows the concrete error and B4 requests recovery action, keeping B focused on a parcel rather than verbal games.

heightening.evidence: B4 collapses departments into A; A5 complies with calling while multiplying the reported causes again.

specificity.evidence: A1 parcel and B2 bus establish the actual failure beneath the bureaucracy.
